The '''RSF Outpost''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] operated by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] in the [[Area D-502]] of the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]].

==History==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the [[Miners Alliance]] purchased resources from [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who docked with the RSF Outpost.

*''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]'' {{1st}}
